title: A client’s habits between meetings
description: A report on the agreed actions and comments for the next meeting. The client chooses which records the coach or trainer sees.

blocks.text: A professional discusses with a client the actions between meetings. A short report can help recall what worked and what they want to talk about, without messaging back and forth about every check-in. Some authors already share progress through an ordinary tracker.

quote.text: This is super easy to use. I’m a personal trainer and work with clients on creating healthier habits. They share with me so I can see their progress throughout the week.

blocks.text: The client selects the records for the period and adds a comment of their own. The professional sees the agreed actions, the misses and the questions for the next meeting. You can start with a report on top of existing records, leaving the client in control of access.

Assemble the material for several real meetings, with the participants’ consent. What changed in the preparation and in the conversation because of the report? If a short message is enough for the professional, a separate dashboard isn’t yet adding the value it needs to.
